name: Chart
summary: The AhaSlides chart library — one framework-free <aha-chart> for all 11 result charts (Bar, Column, Stacked, Donut, Radial, Tree map, Quadrant, Bell curve, Radar, Word cloud, Mind map), in the brand palette on app screens or the deck palette on the presenting canvas.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-chart type="…"> — draws every result chart with the same look wherever it is used: bar, column, stacked, donut (and pie), radial, treemap, quadrant, bell (answer distribution), radar, wordcloud and mindmap. Where it lives decides its colours: palette="brand" (default) for Report and any other app screen uses the --aha-viz-* brand chart palette; palette="deck" on the presenting / audience canvas takes the deck's presentationColorPalette (`colors`) and text colour (`ink`), and derives any ink that sits on a fill from that fill's contrast. The chart never paints a background. Every variant of the reference mockup is an attribute or an `options` key: Poll, Pick Answer (`correct`) and Ranking (`sort="desc"`), images on bar/column options, count / % / both, pagination (`page-size`), donut vs pie and callout / legend labels, the word-cloud shapes, image masks, rotation, colour modes and duplicate merging, the radar forms, grids, scales and eight entrance effects, the bell-curve statistics, and an editable mind map. With 0 responses every bar and column shows a short coloured stub at its starting point — no placeholder bars, no waiting text. Live data animates in place (marks grow, resize and re-rank on the --aha-motion-viz-* tokens; off under reduced motion; `replay()` re-runs the entrance), and every chart ships a text summary, a visually hidden data table and a polite live-region announcement when its data changes. Built-in copy follows `locale`, numbers use Intl for that locale, and the Presenter app can pass its own translations through `strings`.
codeNote: Set `data` (and `options`) as properties for live results — re-setting them animates the change; the `data` / `options` attributes take the same JSON for static pages. Interactive charts emit `wordcloud-hide` (a presenter hid words) and `mindmap-change` (an idea was added or renamed; detail.tree is the new tree). Result charts on app screens use this, not @ant-design/plots.

spec.label: Types
spec.value: bar · column · stacked · donut (variant donut | pie) · radial · treemap · quadrant · bell · radar · wordcloud · mindmap

spec.label: Palette
spec.value: brand = --aha-viz-series-1…6 → the Colour page's Brand slots (the DS has no categorical chart set): brand-1 purple · brand-2 pink · brand-4 mint · brand-6 coral · brand-5 indigo · brand-10 periwinkle; tints → bg-accent · brand-12 · bg-positive · bg-warning-subtle · brand-11 · bg-informative · Other / non-correct → icon-muted · correct → color-success · deck = consumer colours + ink · transparent background · more than 6 bar/column options share series 1

spec.label: Ink
spec.value: ink → text-default · secondary → text-secondary · tertiary → text-tertiary · axis → border-strong · grid → border · track → border-secondary · hover → bg-hover · pressed → border · mark outline → ink-a10 · tooltip → bg-dark + text-inverse · on a deck the same roles are re-derived from the deck ink (76 / 54 / 26 / 12 / 7 / 10 / 8 / 16 % mixes)

spec.label: Bar
spec.value: track 38 (32 past 6 options) · gap --aha-viz-bar-gap (space-24) between options · label-to-bar --aha-space-8 · radius --aha-radius-default (track, fill and empty stub) · value --aha-size-xl / semibold + share --aha-size-l tertiary · image thumbnail = bar + label gap (--aha-space-8) + one label line, bottom-aligned so the bar sits on the image edge; image-only options drop the label row · labels one line with an ellipsis (full text in the tooltip and data table) · value readout in a fixed --aha-viz-value-width (space-100) column so every track ends at the same x · page-size pages with a ‹ › pager

spec.label: Column
spec.value: plot 260 (+100 with images) · column ≤96 wide · gap 28 (20 past 6, 8 under 480) · label clamps to 5 lines · turns into bars when a label can't fit its slot in 4 lines · min height --aha-viz-column-min-height 16

spec.label: Pick Answer
spec.value: correct = index (or data item correct:true): ✓ + bold label; correct-style=fill (default, as the mockup) paints the correct mark --aha-color-success and the rest neutral; correct-style=indicator keeps palette colours (canvas.guide Job 1 / Job 2)

spec.label: Donut · radial · tree map
spec.value: 6 slices max (the rest fold into "Other (n)") · donut ring 38% · leader-line callouts up to 5 slices from 480px wide, else a legend · radial 270° rings on a nice scale · squarified tree map with tint chips

spec.label: Bell · radar · quadrant
spec.value: bell: monotone curve per statement (≤6), average badge, optional grid / % axis / mean line · radar: 5 | 10 | 100 scales, filled / outline / radial bars, polygon / circle grid, 8 entrance effects, subject toggles, data table · quadrant: 2×2 zones, ≤3 colour groups, collision-aware labels

spec.label: Word cloud · mind map
spec.value: word cloud: rect / ellipse / cloud / speech bubble / heart / bulb / custom image mask, rotation, palette / top-3 / ink colour, √ / linear / log sizing, duplicate merging (case, punctuation, accents), click-to-hide with undo · mind map: balanced two-sided layout (one-sided, then an outline when narrow), 5 levels, 6 branches, +N paging, collapse, optional add / rename

spec.label: Empty
spec.value: 0 responses → every bar/column/stacked row keeps its track (a stacked row shows one half-length stub per series side by side, rounded only at the left end) and shows a series-coloured stub at its start: a bar stub --aha-viz-stub-length 12px long, a column stub the full column width and --aha-viz-column-min-height 16px tall (under an image it joins the image card, which rounds only the outer corners), all marks, stubs and image cards rounded with --aha-radius-default · donut / tree map keep the track · radar breathes its entrance effect until the first response · no waiting text

spec.label: Overflow
spec.value: percentages use largest-remainder rounding so they total 100% · bar labels truncate to one line, other long labels clamp; the full text is always in the tooltip · a column with long labels becomes bars · a wide mind map pages its ideas

spec.label: Motion
spec.value: enter 600ms + 40ms stagger · update 400ms · re-rank 350ms · values count up with their marks · --aha-ease-viz · none under prefers-reduced-motion

spec.label: A11y
spec.value: host role=figure + aria-label · text summary · hidden data table (mind map: nested list) · polite <aha-live-region> on data updates · interactive parts (pager, legend toggles, words, mind-map nodes, quadrant points, radar axes) are real buttons with labels

props.name: type
props.desc: Chart type

props.name: data
props.desc: bar/column: [{label?, value, image?, correct?}] (label may be omitted when image is set; screen readers and tooltips then say "Option N") · donut/radial/treemap: [{label, value}] · wordcloud: [{label, value}] or [strings] · stacked: {series, rows:[{label, values}]} · bell: {scale, anchors, series:[{label, counts}]} · radar: {dimensions, scale, subjects:[{label, scores, responses}], people} · quadrant: {x, y, zones, groups, points:[{label, x, y, group}]} · mindmap: {label, children}

props.name: options
props.desc: Type-specific settings — donut {variant, labels, maxSize} · radial/quadrant {maxSize} · treemap {height} · bell {height, show*} · radar {height, form, grid, rings, scoreStyle, reveal, pace, show*, hollowCentre} · wordcloud {height, shape, maskSrc, rotation, colour, fontScale, removable, showTooltip, showCounts, group, foldDiacritics, maxWords} · mindmap {pageSize, maxDepth, maxBranches, editable}

props.name: palette
props.desc: brand on app screens (Report…); deck on the presenting/audience canvas

props.name: colors
props.desc: The deck's presentationColorPalette (palette=deck)

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck text colour (palette=deck)

props.name: number-format
props.desc: What each value shows

props.name: sort
props.desc: Order; desc also shows rank numbers on a bar chart (the Ranking variant). Other always stays last

props.name: highlight-top
props.desc: Dim everything below the top N

props.name: correct
props.desc: Pick Answer: the correct option(s), e.g. "1" (or correct:true on a data item)

props.name: correct-style
props.desc: fill paints the correct mark success-green and the rest neutral (the mockup); indicator keeps palette colours and marks the answer with ✓ only

props.name: page-size
props.desc: Bar: options per page, with a ‹ › pager (ranks carry across pages)

props.name: log-scale
props.desc: Log lengths for bar/column when values span orders of magnitude

props.name: legend
props.desc: Auto: on for stacked, tree map, quadrant groups, multi-subject radar, and a donut without callouts

props.name: tooltip
props.desc: Hover tooltip with the full label and value

props.name: max-items
props.desc: Cap before the smallest fold into "Other (n)"

props.name: responses
props.desc: Respondent count for the summary and the donut centre

props.name: locale
props.desc: Built-in copy (en, vi) + Intl number format

props.name: strings
props.desc: Override any built-in string with the Presenter app's translation

props.name: label
props.desc: Accessible name + data-table caption

props.name: replay()
props.desc: Re-runs the entrance animation with the current data

whenToUse.when: results on the presenting or audience canvas of a slide type — Poll, Pick Answer, Ranking, Rating scale, Split the points, Quadrant, Word cloud, Brainstorm/Mind map
the same results anywhere else in the Presenter app — Report, dashboards, summaries

type="bar" — compare counts across categorical options: long labels, many options (no cap unless max-items is set; extras fold into "Other (n)"), ranking (sort="desc" adds rank numbers), image options, Pick Answer with several options. Serves Poll and Ranking. Not for part-to-whole of one question (use donut) or a time series (use @ant-design/plots).

type="column" — the same comparison for a few short options (Poll, Pick Answer correct reveal). It turns into bars on its own when the labels do not fit the width, so choose bar directly for long labels or many options. Not for part-to-whole (use donut).

type="stacked" — composition of several groups or statements side by side, each row split by the same series (up to 6 series, the rest fold into "Other (n)"). Use when you compare how groups divide, not for one question (use donut).

type="donut" (options.variant="pie" for a solid pie with no centre hole) — part-to-whole of ONE question with few categories (up to 6 slices, the rest fold into "Other (n)"; up to 5 get leader-line callouts when the chart is at least 480px wide, otherwise a legend). Not for many slices or values close together (use bar).
type="radial" — a few shares or percentages shown compactly as concentric rings (up to 6, the rest fold into "Other (n)"). Not for many items or exact comparison (use bar).
type="treemap" — part-to-whole across many categories of very different size (up to 6 tiles, the rest fold into "Other (n)"). Not for precise comparison of close values (use bar).
type="quadrant" — items scored on two axes, such as effort against impact, placed in four labelled quadrants (up to three colour groups). Not for one-dimensional scores (use bar).

type="bell" — how answers are distributed on an ordered or numeric scale: one counts array per scale step, one curve per statement (up to 6) with an average, so the spread, skew or split shows, not just the mean. Use it whenever someone wants to see the distribution of answers, e.g. Rating scale results. Not for unordered categorical options (use bar).
type="radar" — several criteria scored on the same scale (5, 10 or 100), comparing the profile of one or a few subjects. Not for criteria on unrelated scales or a single score (use bar).
type="wordcloud" — frequency of short free-text answers (one string per response, or counted words; up to 120 words shown, duplicates merged). Serves Word cloud. Not for exact counts (use bar).
type="mindmap" — grouped or hierarchical ideas as a tree of labels (default up to 5 levels and 6 branches). Serves Brainstorm and Mind map. Not for quantities (use bar or donut).
a single headline number, not a distribution
a chart type <aha-chart> does not ship (line/area/time series)

opinion.note: Never hand-roll result bars with divs or pull a chart engine into the slide canvas: the look, the empty/overflow states and the accessibility layer live here once. Pick Answer follows the mockup by default (correct mark filled with --aha-color-success, the rest neutral, plus a ✓ on the label); set correct-style="indicator" where the canvas guide's Job 1 / Job 2 split applies (palette-coloured marks, ✓ only). The --aha-viz-* values are lifted from the PRO38-69 mockup and are expected to be refined by a token owner; change the tokens, never the element.
opinion.dsv3: New in the DS (PRO38-69) — the visual source is the "AhaSlides Chart Slides" mockup; a signed-off exception to the @ant-design/plots rule for result charts.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI. The [data-probe] is the ranked brand-palette bar chart: first fill is --aha-viz-series-1, the track and value sizes are the mockup's, the host is a labelled figure and the hidden table carries one row per option.
